_comment: Coverage says a line ran. Mutation testing says a test would have noticed if it were wrong: Stryker rewrites src/ a hundred ways and reports how many of those edits broke a test. `break` is a floor set under the measured score, like the coverage thresholds in vitest.config.ts. Measured on both selftest renders: 84.48 with every feature on, 87.78 with them off. Raise the floor as the suite grows; never lower it to turn a red build green.
